meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行快速开发、渲染和部署 HyperFrames 项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 HyperFrames 做视频渲染并需要 CLI 工作流
copy.tagline_en: Develop, render, and deploy HyperFrames projects from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use HyperFrames for video rendering and need a CLI workflow

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 HyperFrames CLI 命令来创建、编辑、预览和渲染视频项目。它会执行初始化、检查、预览、渲染等操作，并生成视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或编辑视频项目，或诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个视频项目，命名为 myproject。
say.note: Claude 会运行 init 命令创建项目骨架。

say.text: 检查当前项目的代码质量。
say.note: Claude 会运行 lint 和 check 命令。

say.text: 以高质量渲染项目为 out.mp4。
say.note: Claude 会运行 render 命令生成最终视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run HyperFrames CLI commands to scaffold, edit, preview, and render video projects. It executes init, lint, check, preview, render, and other commands to produce video files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit a video project, or when diagnosing build/render failures.

say_en.text: Initialize a video project named myproject.
say_en.note: Claude runs the init command to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Check the current project's code quality.
say_en.note: Claude runs lint and check commands.

say_en.text: Render the project as out.mp4 with high quality.
say_en.note: Claude runs the render command to produce the final video.
